snippet.title: Melody Mania - Trailer - Karaoke game with custom songs - now on Steam
snippet.description:
Let your talent shine when you sing along your favorite songs in this fun party game!

Jump right to the fun with the demo songs that are included with the game. Or add other songs in the community grown UltraStar format.
The integrated editor and AI tools let you create a sing-along version of any song you like, so you'll never run out of options.

Buy now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2394070/Melody_Mania

---
The free Melody Mania Companion App for Android provides additional goodies for the game.

- Use your smartphone as mic. No need to buy new equipment!
- Search and enqueue songs while others are still playing. No need to interrupt the game flow!
- Navigate the game remotely. No need to hang around your keyboard!

Find the Companion app on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.melodymania.MelodyManiaCompanion
